{"metadata":{"description":"Harness agent plugin that acts as a sentinel between the AI agent and MCP servers — polling long-running tasks so token-costly status loops never enter the LLM inference path","id":"gh:1311702182","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"mcp-sentinel","slug":"GCS-ZHN/mcp-sentinel","topics":["dsh-plugin","opencode-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Harness agent plugin that acts as a sentinel between the AI agent and MCP servers — polling long-run"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ning tasks so token-costly status loops never enter the LLM inference path"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# mcp-sentinel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **sentinel** between an AI agent and MCP servers — polling long-running tasks on the agent's behal"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"f so that token-costly status loops never enter the LLM inference path."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"This is a **monorepo**: a harness-agnostic core (`@gcszhn/mcp-sentinel-core`) plus one thin plugin p"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ackage per agent host."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Design principle"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Zero MCP re-configuration.** The sentinel never asks the user to configure MCP
servers of its own."},{"id":"p6s2","text":" Installing the plugin is the whole setup — it discovers and
reuses the MCP servers the harness alre"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ady has, in whichever way that harness
exposes them:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **From the host's MCP config** — OpenCode. The plugin reads
`client.config.get().mcp` and hands th"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e resolved servers to the core, which
owns the connection lifecycle. No extra MCP setup.
- **Through"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" the harness SDK** — DeepSeek Harness. The plugin calls the
`mcp__<server>__<tool>` tools already re"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"gistered by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` via `ctx.tools.execute`. No extra MCP setup.
- **As a harn"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ess-agnostic MCP CLI** — any harness. `mcp-sentinel mcp --harness
<codex|opencode|custom>` is a plai"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n stdio MCP server that discovers the MCP
servers the harness already exposes (`codex mcp list --jso"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"n`, `opencode debug
config`, or a `--mcp-config` file) and skips its own entry. No message
notificat"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ion channel by default — agents collect results with
attach/status/read, unless they opt into a comm"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"and-based notifier via
`mcp_sentinel_set_notifier_commands`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The agent immediately sees the MCP servers it already configured for that
harness; there is no senti"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nel-specific MCP config, mock server, or demo wiring
to maintain."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Supported harnesses"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Install instructions and per-harness details live in each plugin's own README."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Harness           | Plugin package                                                                "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"                                               | Docs                                          |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| OpenCode          | `@gcszhn/mcp-sentinel-opencode-plugin`                 | README         |
| De"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"epSeek Harness  | `@gcszhn/mcp-sentinel-deepseek-harness-plugin` | README |
| Any harness (CLI) | `@"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"gcszhn/mcp-sentinel-cli`                                         | README              |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The shared core ships separately as `@gcszhn/mcp-sentinel-core` — see its README."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Motivation"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"When an agent submits a long-running job through an MCP tool, it must repeatedly call the server to "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"check progress — each round-trip burns context window tokens."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**mcp-sentinel** moves the polling loop out of the agent and into the plugin runtime — 2 inference c"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"alls regardless of task duration."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Environment variables for controlling memory usage:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Variable                | Default   | Description                                       |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| `SENTINEL_MAX_POLL_LOG` | unlimited | Max poll log entries per task (FIFO trim)         |
